title: Harbor Admin: choose the console's structure
question: The roll dealt three ways to organise the admin console in Harbor's existing look. Lock one, steer, or re-roll.

options.label: Attention board
options.lineage: airport departures board, reranking in place
options.thesis: Home is one ranked board of everything that needs an admin's decision, reranking live as cases age and escalate.
options.viewport: Ink side rail; a full-height 'Needs a decision' board ranked by urgency, rows expand inline into the case with Hide / Remove / Dismiss; a right column of network-pulse sparklines.
options.risk: If too many low-stakes rows reach the board it turns into a noisy feed; ranking rules must be strict.

raised.raise: A changed row moves to its new rank instead of vanishing, and stays lit amber until the admin has seen it.

options.label: Platform lanes
options.thesis: Home compares iOS, Android and Web in three parallel lanes, so health and reports read per platform at a glance.
options.viewport: Ink top bar with tabs; three lanes (iOS, Android, Web) each with signups, DAU, crash-free rate and open reports; moderation opens as a right drawer.
options.risk: Moderation, the most frequent job, is one click further away than in the other two.

options.label: Admin Brief
options.lineage: Harbor Brief, written for the people who run Harbor
options.thesis: Home is a written daily Brief of what happened on Harbor, with the action for each line inline, under a command bar that finds any member, post or report.
options.viewport: Top command bar; a centred Brief column of sentences ('3 reports on Mateo's studio post, 2 from the same account') each ending in its action; metrics as a slim strip above.
options.risk: Prose is slower to scan than a table when the day is busy.
